shortDescription: Parse native config/state from a file or device.

options.name: file_path
options.description: Path to a file to load native config/state from. Note: Either file_path or data to connect to a device must be provided. Note: file_path takes precedence over a live device

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the device you want to connect to

options.name: mode
options.description: Whether to parse config/state or both. Note: `both` is not supported in combination with `file_path`.

options.name: models
options.description: A list that should match the SUPPORTED_MODELS in napalm-yang

options.name: optional_args
options.description: Dictionary of additional arguments passed to underlying driver

options.name: provider
options.description: Dictionary which acts as a collection of arguments used to define the characteristics of how to connect to the device. Note - hostname, username, password and dev_os must be defined in either provider or local param if we want to parse from a device Note - local param takes precedence, e.g. hostname is preferred to provider['hostname']

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for the device to respond
